Caused by my numpy 2.4.6 vs whatever produced the committed file. Cosmetic but means the data env does not reproduce committed bytes exactly. Decide: pin numpy version, or accept and commit.
close_reason: Investigated and reverted. The 116 float diffs (worst 4.3e-05) are all in unused fit params: 0 diffs in any frontier point and 0 diffs in any rendered string (alpha/rmse/bestLoss/nFrontier all identical; amplitude/floor differ only below the page's display precision). numpy-version noise, invisible to users. title: README says verify_data.py diffs against the authors' .tex; it diffs against committed artefacts
Reward.tsx: 'shuffle is worse on 10 of 10' counts a printed tie as a loss
description: From the review. reward_arms.tex prints None, uniform AND shuffle all bold on the random-bytes row. Bundle: shuffle 8.0235 vs none 8.0204, delta 0.0031, so compareArms files it under 'worse'. Honest count is 9 worse + 1 tie. close_reason: Fixed: compareArms on Reward.tsx now has a TIE_EPS=0.005 bucket matching the tex's 2dp print precision, so shuffle reads 'worse on 9 of 10 (and ties it on 1: random bytes)' instead of 10/10.

title: Scaling.tsx: figure-2 arm compute axis does not match the authors' per-rung pools
description: From the review, and the most consequential data finding. tools/build_data.py effective_compute hardcodes P.POOL (1536) for all three arms, but the authors' fig2.py uses per-rung programs_per_round for the two fixed arms (prior: 1024/2048/1024/2048/1024; pcfg: 512/2048/2048/1024/1024). Recomputing with the authors' pools flips metamath from a tie to a pcfg win (3.064 vs 3.274) and moves every selfplay/pcfg loss in the table. The defect is in build_data.py, not the page, but the page asserts a fidelity the data lacks. Fix belongs upstream; needs a decision on scope.
close_reason: Fixed: arm_pool() in build_data.py reads the authors' per-rung *_programs_per_round.json for the two fixed arms (bundle key 'uniform' maps to file 'prior'); self-play stays at constant 1536. scaling.json regenerated. 13 new checks in verify_data.py recover the pool from C/(K*N*CTX*(r+1)) and assert selfplay=1536 constant and the others multi-valued; verified they fail (4 failures) when a constant pool is reintroduced. 165/165 pass.

title: Method.tsx: Eq 3/4/5 are unsourced reconstructions presented under PaperRef
description: From the 4-way review. No artifact contains Eq 3 (g_0=|A|^-len + KL), Eq 4 (GRPO normaliser) or Eq 5 (w=max(0,r-tau)).
